blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reasoning about the 3D world from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While modern MLLMs handle single-image inputs effectively, they struggle to integrate evidence across viewpoints into a coherent 3D understanding. A growing body of work attempts to close this gap by injecting 3D awareness into MLLMs, either by boosting fine-grained pixel-level cross-view correspondence or by fusing features from 3D geometry foundation models, yet a substantial gap to human reasoning persists. In this work, we revisit human spatial reasoning, which suggests that rather than relying on fine-grained geometry cues, humans roughly identify common objects across views, infer the relative geometry between viewpoints, and assemble a coarse 3D layout of the scene. Inspired by this process, we introduce Imagine3D-LLM , an MLLM that learns to assemble a similar compact 3D representation of the scene and conditions its answer on this representation. Concretely, we append a small set of learnable summary tokens after the image tokens, decode them into a compact 3D Gaussian Splatting representation supervised by a photometric reconstruction loss, and train jointly with the standard next-token prediction objective. Notably, although only the summary tokens receive direct reconstruction supervision, this objective also induces stronger cross-frame correspondence within the LLM’s underlying image features, suggesting that learning to reconstruct propagates 3D-aware signals throughout the model. As a result, Imagine3D-LLM consistently outperforms prior approaches across multiple spatial reasoning and 3D understanding benchmarks, suggesting that imagining the scene can be more effective than being told its pixel-wise geometry.
blocks.zh: 从多视图图像来解释3D世界仍然是多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的根本挑战. 现代的MLLMs虽然有效地处理单一图像输入,但很难将不同观点的证据纳入一致的3D理解中. 越来越多的工作试图通过向MLLMs注入3D意识来弥补这一差距,要么通过增强精细的像素水平交叉视图通信,要么通过从3D几何基础模型中引信特征,然而与人类推理的巨大差距依然存在. 在这部作品中,我们重新审视了人类的空间推理,这说明人类与其依赖精细的几何提示,不如大致辨别各种观点之间的共同物体,推断观点之间的相对几何,并组装了场景粗糙的3D布局. 在这一过程的启发下,我们引入了Imagine3D-LLM,这是一个MLLM,它学习将场景的类似紧凑的3D代表集合起来,并给它对这一代表的回答提供了条件. 具体地说,我们在图像符号之后附加了一小组可学习的汇总符号,把它们解码成一个紧凑的3D高斯电镀表示器,由光度重建损失监督,并结合标准下键预测目标一起训练. 值得注意的是,虽然只有简要符号接受直接的重建监督,但这一目标也促使LLM的基本图像特征内有更强的跨框架通信,表明学习重建在整个模型中传播3D-意识信号。 因此,Imagine3D-LLM在跨多个空间推理和3D理解基准的以往方法上,一贯的超越效果,说明想象场景比被告知其像素几何效果更有效.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Reasoning about 3D structure from multi-view images is a fundamental problem in computer vision, underpinning a wide range of downstream applications such as robotics [ 62 ] , embodied AI [ 91 ] , AR/VR [ 6 ] , and scene understanding [ 1 ] . Driven by rapid progress in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) [ 80 , 4 , 34 , 66 ] , machines can now interpret a single image or a continuous video stream at a level that often rivals, and in some cases surpasses, human performance [ 85 , 50 ] . However, when the input shifts from a single viewpoint to a set of multi-view images that demand genuine 3D reasoning, even the largest and most capable models fall short of human-level competence [ 82 ] .
blocks.zh: 从多视图图像来解释3D结构是计算机视觉中的一个基本问题,支撑了机器人[62],体现AI[91],AR/VR[6],场景理解[1]等广泛的下游应用. 在多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)[80,4,34,66]的迅猛进步的推动下,机器现在可以解释一个单一的图像或连续的视频流,其水平往往与人的表现相竞争,有时甚至超越人的表现[85,50]. 然而,当输入从一个单一角度转向一组需要真正三维推理的多视图图像时,即使是最大和最有能力的模型也不足以满足人的能力[82].

blocks.en: A growing body of work has attempted to close this gap by injecting strong 3D priors into MLLMs. One line of research implicitly or explicitly boosts pixel-level correspondences across views by either embedding scene point clouds’ 3D coordinates into patch-level features [ 93 , 96 , 73 ] , augmenting images with explicit visual markers [ 58 ] , distilling features with accurate correspondences [ 33 ] , or designing pretext tasks that encourage the model to align overlapping content across frames [ 73 ] . A complementary line [ 92 , 23 , 30 ] fuses MLLM image features with ones from recently developed 3D reconstruction foundation models such as CUT3R [ 76 ] and VGGT [ 74 ] . While both approaches attempt to improve 3D awareness of MLLMs with fine-grained pixel-level 3D signals, these approaches yield only incremental gains [ 82 , 87 ] .
blocks.zh: 越来越多的工作试图通过向MLLMs注入强大的3D前身来缩小这一差距。 一行研究通过将场景点云的3D坐标嵌入到补丁级特征中[93,96,73],用明确的视觉标记增强图像[58],用准确的对应文字提炼特征[33],或者设计借口任务鼓励模型将重叠内容调和到不同框架之间[73],从而隐含或明确促进像素级别的对视. 一条补充线[92,23,30]将MLLM图像特征与最近开发的3D重建基础模型,如CUT3R[76]和VGGT[74]的特征相连接. 虽然这两种方法都试图用精细的像素级3D信号提高MLLMs的3D意识,但这些方法只产生增量收益[82,87].

blocks.en: In this work, we take a step back and ask whether such fine-grained 3D signals are truly the most direct route to improved 3D reasoning. To answer this, we revisit how humans actually perceive 3D structure from multi-view observations. Cognitive studies suggest that humans do not maintain pixel-perfect correspondences or dense depth maps in their heads [ 7 , 63 ] . When presented with several views of a scene, humans instead identify common objects across views, use them as anchors to infer coarse and abstract spatial relationships between viewpoints, and mentally assemble a compact layout of the scene in 3D. Therefore, we hypothesize that the representation that supports their downstream reasoning is rather object-level and approximate, not pixel-accurate.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们退一步,问这种精细的3D信号是否真正是改进3D推理的最直接途径. 为了回答这个问题,我们重新审视了人类如何从多视图观测中实际看待三维结构. 认知研究表明,人类在头部没有保持像素完美对应或密集的深度图[7,63]. 当呈现出对一个场景的几种观点时,人类反而识别出不同观点的共同物体,用它们作为锚点来推断观点之间的粗糙和抽象的空间关系,精神上用3D来组装场景的紧凑布局. 因此,我们假设,支持其下游推理的表述是相当客观和近似的,而不是像素精确的.

blocks.en: Inspired by this human thinking process, we present Imagine3D-LLM , a framework that enables an MLLM to build an analogous compact 3D reconstruction of the scene before answering. To enable this, we introduce a compact set of learnable Gaussian summary tokens , which are appended to the sequence of image tokens fed into the LLM. From these tokens, we decode the parameters of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 42 ] primitives, so that each Gaussian summary token corresponds to a small set of 3D Gaussians that together explain a portion of the scene.
blocks.zh: 受这个人类思维过程的启发,我们提出了Imagine3D-LLM,这个框架使得MLLM在回答前能够构建类似的紧凑的3D重建场景. 为了实现这一点,我们引入了一套可学习的高斯摘要符号,附在输入LLM的图像符号序列中。 从这些代币中,我们解码了3D高斯镀(3DGS)[42]原始物的参数,这样,每个高斯简易代币就对应了一小组3D高斯人,共同解释一部分场景.

blocks.en: To efficiently and effectively enable MLLMs to build an abstract and compact reconstruction of the scene, our Gaussian estimation pipeline incorporates two deliberate design choices. (1) To prevent the model from simply copy-pasting 2D image content into image-aligned Gaussians rather than recovering the underlying geometry, we predict the Gaussians from the dedicated Gaussian summary tokens instead of predicting them directly from the image features. (2) We impose an information bottleneck by using fewer Gaussian summary tokens than image tokens, which compels overlapping content across views to be merged into a shared set of tokens, encouraging the model to reason about which objects recur across views and how they fit together within a unified 3D layout.
blocks.zh: 为了高效和有效地使MLLMs能够对现场进行抽象和紧凑的重建,我们的高斯估计管道包含了两个有意的设计选择. (1)为了防止模型简单地将2D图像内容复制成图像对齐的高斯人,而不是恢复基础几何,我们从专用的高斯人摘要符号中预测高斯人,而不是直接从图像特征中预测. (2)我们通过使用比图像符号更少的高斯摘要符号来强加一个信息瓶颈,这迫使不同观点的重叠内容被合并成一组共享的符号,鼓励模型解释哪些物体在各种观点之间反复出现,以及它们如何在统一的3D布局下组合在一起.

blocks.en: We jointly train Imagine3D-LLM with a photometric reconstruction loss on the rendered Gaussians and the standard next-token prediction loss for language modeling. Surprisingly, although only the Gaussian summary tokens receive direct reconstruction supervision, our analysis shows that the LLM’s image features themselves become more 3D-aware: corresponding image features show more sharp attentions, where PCA visualizations further reveal that image features become more semantically organized, with the same object encoded consistently across views. These analyses validate that requiring the model to infer the underlying structure of the scene propagates 3D-aware signals throughout the LLM, reshaping its internal representations toward a coherent, object-centric 3D understanding. As a result, Imagine3D-LLM achieves significant performance gains across seven diverse spatial reasoning and 3D scene understanding benchmarks, suggesting that abstract scene reconstruction is a powerful inductive bias for building 3D-aware MLLMs, and that imagining the scene before answering can be more effective than being told its pixel-wise geometry.
blocks.zh: 我们联合训练了Imagine3D-LLM, 其光度测量重建损失在高斯人身上, 令人惊讶的是,虽然只有高斯语摘要符号接受直接的重建监督,但我们的分析表明LLM的图像特征本身变得更加具有3D意识:对应的图像特征表现出更加尖锐的注意,其中PCA的可视化进一步揭示了图像特征变得更加有条不紊,同一对象在各种观点中一致地编码. 这些分析证实,要求模型推断场景的基本结构在整个LLM中传播3D-意识信号,重新塑造其内部表述,以一致的、以物体为中心的3D理解。 因此,Imagine3D-LLM在7个不同的空间推理和3D场景理解基准中取得了显著的性能收益,这表明抽象场景重建对于构建3D-意识的MLLM是一种强大的诱导偏差,在回答前想象场景比被告知其像素几何效果更有效.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Grounding natural language in 3D environments is a long-standing goal of the 3D scene understanding community, supporting tasks such as 3D visual grounding [ 10 , 88 ] , 3D dense captioning [ 11 , 13 , 14 ] , and 3D question answering [ 3 , 52 , 51 , 82 ] . A prominent line of work distills features from 2D foundation models (most commonly CLIP [ 60 ] or LSeg [ 46 ] ) into a reconstructed scene representation, including point clouds [ 81 , 94 , 36 ] , NeRFs [ 43 , 22 ] , and more recently 3D Gaussian Splatting [ 39 , 59 , 64 ] , enabling open-vocabulary querying by matching distilled embeddings to a text prompt. These pipelines, however, typically rely on task-specific architectures and per-scene optimization, and their language understanding is bounded by the compositional capacity of the underlying 2D embedding model. We instead extend the language and visual reasoning of pretrained MLLMs to multi-view inputs, allowing a single generalist model to address these tasks through natural language without per-task or per-scene optimization.
blocks.zh: 在3D环境中定位自然语言是3D场景理解社区的长期目标,支持3D视觉定位[10,88],3D密集字幕[11,13,14],3D问题回答[3,52,51,82]等任务. 2D基础模型(最常见的是CLIP[60]或LSeg[46])中突出的工作线特征蒸馏成重建的场景代表,包括点云[81,94,36],NERFs[43,22],以及最近的3D高斯镀版[39,59,64],通过将蒸馏嵌入物匹配到文本提示器上,使得开口查询成为可能. 然而,这些管道通常依赖于任务特定架构和每个场景优化,其语言理解以基础2D嵌入模型的构成能力为限制. 我们转而将预先训练的MLLMs的语言和视觉推理扩展到多视图输入,允许一个单一的通论模型通过自然语言来解决这些问题,而无需每个任务或每个场景优化.

blocks.en: Motivated by the success of 2D MLLMs [ 4 , 80 , 34 , 45 , 48 , 49 , 66 , 69 , 75 , 84 ] , a growing body of work extends them to 3D understanding. Early efforts feed explicit 3D inputs to the LLM, either by lifting 2D features into 3D [ 96 , 29 ] or by training dedicated point-cloud encoders as an additional modality [ 12 , 78 , 32 , 79 ] ; the scarcity of paired 3D–language data, however, has limited their performance on language-heavy tasks. More recent approaches retain the multi-view 2D input format and inject 3D awareness through training objectives or auxiliary modules. One family supplies pixel-level 3D signals to encourage cross-view correspondence: Video-3D-LLM [ 93 ] and LLaVA-3D [ 96 ] attach 3D positional embeddings derived from input point clouds, GPT4Scene [ 58 ] renders bird’s-eye-view markers, Ross3D [ 73 ] adds a cross-view reconstruction pretext task, and 3DRS [ 33 ] distills features with explicit correspondence supervision. A second family fuses MLLM image features with representations from 3D foundation models [ 76 , 74 ] to expose the LLM to dense, geometry-aware features, as in VLM3R [ 23 ] , G 2 \text{G}^{2} VLM [ 30 ] , and the concurrent 3DThinker [ 17 ] . Despite steady progress, a substantial gap to human-level performance on multi-view 3D reasoning benchmarks remains [ 82 ] .
blocks.zh: 由于2D MLLMs[4,80,34,45,48,49,66,69,75,84]的成功激励,越来越多的工作将其扩展到3D理解. 早期的努力为LLM提供了明确的3D输入,要么将2D特性提升到3D[96,29],要么培训专用的点云编码器作为附加模式[12,78,32,79];然而,配对的3D-语言数据很少,限制了它们在语言繁重任务上的性能. 较近期的方法保留了多视图2D输入格式,并通过培训目标或辅助模块注入3D意识. 一个家族提供像素级的3D信号,鼓励交叉视图通信:Video-3D-LLM [93]和LLaVA-3D [96] 附加从输入点云中衍生出来的3D位置嵌入,GPT4Scene [58] 使鸟眼-视觉标记,Ross3D [73] 增加了交叉视图重建借口任务,3DRS [33] 蒸馏特性具有明确的通信监督. 第二个家族将MLLM图像特征与3D基础模型[76,74]的表示相融合,使LLM暴露于密集,几何感知的特征,如VLM3R [23],G 2\text{G}^{2}VLM [30],以及同时存在的3DThinker [17]. 尽管取得了稳步进展,但在多视角3D推理基准方面,与人层面业绩的差距仍然很大[82]。

blocks.en: Cognitive studies suggest that humans do not maintain pixel-accurate reconstructions of every surface; rather, they rely on coarse abstractions that are nonetheless sufficient to support rich spatial reasoning [ 7 , 63 , 44 ] . A line of work in 3D vision has correspondingly explored decomposing scenes into compact geometric primitives such as meshes, polygons, or superquadrics [ 70 , 57 , 56 , 24 , 54 ] , but these methods either struggle to scale beyond a handful of primitives [ 54 ] or rely on off-the-shelf 3D instance segmentation [ 24 ] . More recently, C3G [ 1 ] introduced a feed-forward pipeline that represents a scene compactly with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) parameters, decoding 3D Gaussians from a small set of learnable query tokens supervised purely through photometric rendering. Inspired by this line of work, we bring token-level Gaussian decoding inside an MLLM, where a small set of Gaussian summary tokens learns to assemble a compact 3D representation of the scene that the LLM conditions on when reasoning about it.
blocks.zh: 认知研究表明,人类并不保持每个表面的像素精确重建;相反,他们依赖于粗糙的抽象,这些抽象仍然足以支持丰富的空间推理[7,63,44]. 3D视觉中的一行工作相应地探索了将场景分解成紧凑的几何原始物,如 meshes,多边形,或超方形[70,57,56,24,54],但这些方法要么挣扎于超越少数原始物[54],要么依赖于现成的3D实例分化[24]. 最近,C3G [1]引入了一条向导的管道,该管道与3D高斯电镀(3DGS)参数紧凑地代表了场景,将3D高斯电镀从一套小的可学习的查询符中解码出来,完全通过光度渲染来监督. 受这行工作的启发,我们把象征级的高斯解码带入一个MLLM,其中一小组高斯摘要符号学习组装一个紧凑的3D代表场景,LLM在对此进行推理时附加条件.

Given multi-view images of a scene and a text instruction, our model appends a compact set of learnable Gaussian summary tokens between the image and text tokens. At an intermediate layer ℓ \ell , the hidden states at the Gaussian summary token positions are decoded into a compact 3D Gaussian Splatting representation that abstractly reconstructs the scene. The model is trained jointly with a standard language modeling loss on the text output, a photometric reconstruction loss obtained by rendering the predicted Gaussians at the input viewpoints, and a distillation loss from a pretrained compact Gaussian teacher [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 图1:Impic3D-LLM的整体架构. 鉴于一个场景和文本指示的多视图图像,我们的模型在图像和文本符号之间附加了一套可学习的高斯摘要符号。 在中间层 l\ell 中,隐藏在高斯摘要符号位置的状态被解码为紧凑的 3D 高斯平板化代表,抽象地重建了场景. 该模型与标准语言模型在文本输出上的丢失,通过在输入角度使预测的高斯人得到的光度重建损失,以及经过预先训练的紧凑型高斯人教师的蒸馏损失[1]共同训练.

blocks.en: 3.2 Imagine3D-LLM
blocks.zh: 3.2 设想3D-LLM

blocks.en: We now describe how we equip a multi-image MLLM with the ability to perform mental 3D reconstruction of the input scene for improved 3D reasoning. At a high level, we introduce a compact set of learnable Gaussian summary tokens that are appended to the image tokens fed into the LLM (§ 3.2.1 ). These tokens learn to summarize the multi-view observations into a compact set of 3D Gaussians, jointly trained with the reconstruction and standard language modeling objective. Since pure photometric supervision is known to require lengthy training schedules even for learning Gaussians alone [ 16 , 9 , 83 , 28 , 37 , 1 ] , we further introduce a distillation objective from a pretrained Gaussian teacher model [ 72 ] , to substantially accelerate convergence (§ 3.2.2 ). Finally, we analyze how this joint training improves the MLLM’s internal representations (§ 3.3 ). An overview of our method is shown in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们现在描述我们如何装备一个多图像的MLLM,能够对输入场景进行心智3D重建,以改善3D推理. 在高层次上,我们推出一套紧凑的可学习的高斯摘要符号,附在输入LLM的图像符号上(第3.2.1节)。 这些标志学将多景观测总结为一套紧凑的3D高斯人,与重建和标准语言建模目标共同训练. 由于纯粹的测光监督,即使是仅对学习高斯人来说都需要长时间的训练时间表[16,9,83,28,37,1]],我们进一步从预先训练好的高斯人教师模式[72]引入了蒸馏目标,以大大加速趋同(§3.2.2). 最后,我们分析这种联合培训如何改进劳动和劳工部的内部表述(第3.3节)。 图1概述了我们的方法。

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Mental Reconstruction via Gaussian Summary Tokens
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 通过高斯提要进行精神重建

blocks.en: Given the visual token sequence 𝐞 img ∈ ℝ K ​ N ′ × D \mathbf{e}^{\mathrm{img}}\in\mathbb{R}^{KN^{\prime}\times D} produced by the vision encoder and projector, we introduce a compact set of M M learnable Gaussian summary tokens 𝐞 gs ∈ ℝ M × D \mathbf{e}^{\mathrm{gs}}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times D} , where M ≪ K ​ N ′ M\ll KN^{\prime} . These tokens are inserted between the visual tokens and the textual tokens, yielding the augmented multimodal sequence [ 𝐞 img ; 𝐞 gs ; 𝐞 text ] ∈ ℝ ( K ​ N ′ + M + L ) × D , [\mathbf{e}^{\mathrm{img}};\,\mathbf{e}^{\mathrm{gs}};\,\mathbf{e}^{\mathrm{text}}]\in\mathbb{R}^{(KN^{\prime}+M+L)\times D}, (4) which is processed by the LLM via standard causal self-attention. By placing the Gaussian summary tokens after the image tokens, each token can attend to all visual evidence and selectively retrieve the information needed to faithfully describe a portion of the 3D scene, rather than being passively bound to local image content.
blocks.zh: 鉴于视觉符号序列 e igg ∈ R K N ′ D \ mathbf{ e}^{\ mathrm{ img}}\in\ mathbb{ R}^{KN^{\prime}\tims D}由视觉编码器和投影机制作,我们引入一套紧凑的M M 可学习的Gaussian摘要符号 e gs → R M → D mathbf{e}^{\mathrm{gs}}\in\mathb{R}^{M\times D},其中M≪ K N → M\ll KN^{\prime}. 在视觉符号和文字符号之间插入这些符号,产生增强的多模式序列[ e img; e ; e 文本] → R (K N + M + L ) , [\ mathbf{ e}^{\ mathrm{ img}};\,\ mathbf{ e}^{\ mathrm{ gs}};\,\,\ mathb{ e}^{\ mathrm{ text}}]\\ in\ mathbb{R}^{(K^{\prime}+M+L)\time D}, (4) LLM通过标准的因果自觉处理. 通过将高斯摘要符号放在图像符号之后,每个符号可以关注所有视觉证据,并有选择地检索忠实描述部分3D场景所需的信息,而不是被动地绑定在本地图像内容上.

blocks.en: A central design choice is that the number of Gaussian summary tokens is substantially smaller than the number of image tokens, M ≪ K ​ N ′ M\ll KN^{\prime} . This bottleneck prevents the model from naively allocating one token per pixel or per patch, and instead forces overlapping content observed across multiple views to be merged into a shared set of tokens. Under this constraint, the most efficient way for the model to faithfully reconstruct the scene with limited Gaussians is to assign each token to a coherent 3D region or object that recurs across views. As we show in § 3.3 , this bottleneck gives rise to an emergent object-centric grouping, mirroring the way humans build object-level mental abstractions of a scene before reasoning about it. Since our main objective is to improve 3D reasoning rather than novel view synthesis, this design also offers a favorable trade-off between reconstruction quality and computational cost, preventing the input sequence length to increase substantially.
blocks.zh: 一个中央设计选择是高斯摘要符号的数量大大小于图像符号的数量,M QQ K N ' M\ll KN^{\prime}. 这种瓶颈使模型无法天真地分配每个像素或每个补丁一个令牌,相反,迫使从多个视图中观察到的重叠内容被合并成一组共享的令牌. 在这种制约下,模型用有限的高斯人来忠实地重建场景的最有效方式是将每个符号指定给一个相互重复的连贯的3D区域或对象. 正如我们在第3.3节中所显示的那样,这个瓶颈导致了一个以物体为中心的新兴组合,在推理之前就反映了人类构建一个场景的物体级精神抽象的手法. 由于我们的主要目标是改进3D推理而不是新颖的视图综合,这种设计也为重建质量和计算成本提供了有利的权衡,防止输入序列长度大幅上升.

blocks.en: Given the LLM forward pass over the augmented sequence [ 𝐞 img ; 𝐞 gs ; 𝐞 text ] [\mathbf{e}^{\mathrm{img}};\,\mathbf{e}^{\mathrm{gs}};\,\mathbf{e}^{\mathrm{text}}] , a natural question is from which layer the Gaussian summary tokens should be decoded. Recent analyses [ 40 , 90 , 38 , 41 , 84 ] consistently identify that the middle layers of the LLM most actively show information flow between visual and text modalities. Since our Gaussian summary tokens also require effectively absorbing visual information from the image tokens, we extract the hidden states at the Gaussian summary token positions from the middle layer ℓ \ell , denoted 𝐡 gs ∈ ℝ M × D \mathbf{h}^{\mathrm{gs}}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times D} . Decoding at a middle layer also leaves enough subsequent layers for the text tokens to attend to the Gaussian summary tokens, enabling the text tokens to benefit from the scene-summarizing information encoded by the Gaussian tokens. The effectiveness of choosing ℓ \ell as a middle layer is further validated in Tab. 5 .

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Accelerating Convergence via Distillation from a Compact Gaussian Teacher
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 通过消沉加速高斯大陆教师的融合

blocks.en: Although the model can in principle be trained end-to-end with the objective above, we find that pure photometric supervision through the LLM converges slowly, requiring substantially more iterations than is practical given the cost of MLLM finetuning. This is consistent with prior observations in the feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting literature, where dedicated estimators are typically trained for hundreds of thousands of iterations with large batch sizes to obtain reliable Gaussian predictions [ 16 , 9 , 83 , 28 , 37 , 1 ] . To circumvent this bottleneck, we leverage a pretrained compact Gaussian estimator as a teacher model and distill its scene representation into the LLM, providing a strong inductive signal for what the Gaussian summary tokens should encode.
blocks.zh: 虽然该模型原则上可以按照上述目标进行端到端的训练,但我们发现,通过LLM进行纯光度监测的聚合速度缓慢,考虑到MLLM微调的成本,需要的迭代比实际多得多。 这与前传的3D高斯白板文学中先前的观察是一致的,在文献中,专用的估测器一般会接受数十万次分批量大小的迭代训练,以获得可靠的高斯预测[16,9,83,28,37,1]. 为了绕过这个瓶颈,我们利用一个事先训练好的紧凑的高斯印象器作为教师模型,并把它的场景表现分解到LLM中,为高斯摘要符号应该编码的内容提供强烈的感应信号.

Crucially, we match the number of teacher tokens M M in ZipSplat’s inference time with the number of Gaussian summary tokens in our LLM, allowing direct token-level alignment between teacher and student.

blocks.en: 3.3 Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 分析

blocks.en: In this section, we further analyze the characteristics of the trained model to understand how jointly training the model to estimate coarse reconstructions of the scene leads to improved 3D reasoning.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们进一步分析了训练有素的模型的特征,以了解如何联合训练模型来估计场景粗糙的重建导致改进的3D推理.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Effects of joint reconstruction training on the LLM’s image features. (a) Image-to-image attention maps between a query point ( red dot) and other input views. Our model exhibits substantially stronger cross-view correspondences than the baseline, indicating that the Gaussian summary tokens implicitly drive the image features to align across views. (b) PCA visualization of the LLM’s image features (first three components shown as RGB). Our features are noticeably cleaner and more semantically structured, with corresponding objects (e.g., chairs, desks) encoded with consistent colors across views, reflecting the emergence of object-level abstractions.
blocks.zh: 图 2:联合重建培训对LLM形象特征的影响. (a) 一个查询点(红点)与其他输入视图之间的图像到图像的注意图。 我们的模型显示的交叉视图对应比基线要强得多,表明高斯摘要符号暗含着推动图像特性在各种观点之间保持一致。 (b) LLM图像特性的PCA可视化(前三个组件显示为RGB)。 我们的特征明显更清洁,结构更精密,相应的物体(如椅子,桌子)以一致的颜色编码,各种观点,反映了物体级抽象的出现.

blocks.en: While our reconstruction loss is applied only at the Gaussian summary tokens and does not directly supervise the image features, we observe that the LLM’s image features themselves become substantially more 3D-aware after joint training. Fig. 2 -(a) visualizes the attention maps between a query point in one view ( red dot) and the image features of the other input views. Compared to the baseline, our model produces noticeably sharper and more spatially focused attention on the corresponding region across views, indicating that the same object is now encoded with consistent representations regardless of viewpoint. Beyond this qualitative observation, we additionally evaluate cross-view correspondence accuracy of our model’s image features throughout training, and observe a steady improvement as training progresses (Appendix B ). Fig. 2 -(b) makes the underlying structure more explicit by visualizing the first three principal components of the image-token hidden states at the ℓ \ell -th LLM layer in RGB. While the baseline features appear noisy and largely unstructured, our features are markedly cleaner and more semantically organized, with corresponding regions encoded with consistent colors across viewpoints. Together, these two effects indicate that the reconstruction objective propagates 3D-aware structure beyond the Gaussian summary tokens into the LLM’s image features themselves, encouraging the same kind of compact, view-consistent representation that the summary tokens are trained to produce.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的重建损失只应用在高斯摘要标志上,并不直接监督图像特征,但我们观察到LLM的图像特征本身在经过联合训练后会大大增强3D意识. 图2-(a)可视化一个视图中查询点(红点)与其他输入视图的图像特征之间的关注图. 与基线相比,我们的模型对不同观点的相应区域产生了明显更尖锐和更在空间上集中的注意,表明现在无论观点如何,同一物体都以一致的表示编码。 除了这种定性观察之外,我们还在整个培训过程中评估了我们模型图像特征的交叉视图对应精度,并观察到随着培训进展的稳步改善(附录B ) 。 图2-(b ) 通过在 RGB 的l\ell-th LLM 层中可视化图像脚本隐藏状态的前三个主要组成部分,使基础结构更加清晰。 虽然基线特征看起来很吵,基本没有结构,但我们的特征明显比较干净,更有条理,相应的区域以不同观点的一致颜色编码。 这两项效果表明,重建目标将3D-意识结构传播到高斯语摘要符号之外,进入LLM的图像特征本身,鼓励与摘要符号训练成的类似紧凑,与视觉一致的表述.

We visualize the Gaussians clustered from a set of Gaussian summary tokens via K-means over the summary tokens ( cyan indicates the Gaussians belonging to one cluster). Similar summary tokens are mapped to the same object without any explicit clustering supervision.

blocks.en: A central design choice of Imagine3D-LLM is the bottleneck M ≪ K ​ N ′ M\ll KN^{\prime} , which compels overlapping content across views to be merged into a shared set of summary tokens (§ 3.2.1 ). To examine whether this bottleneck actually induces object-level grouping, we cluster the trained summary tokens via K-means and visualize, for each cluster, the 3D Gaussians decoded from its member tokens. As shown in Fig. 3 , a single cluster’s Gaussians reliably localize one object (e.g., the chair) across all views, despite the model receiving no clustering supervision. This emergent grouping effectively validates that learning to reconstruct the scene through a small set of summary tokens naturally guides the model toward the abstract, object-level understanding our design aims to achieve, without requiring any explicit object-level supervision.
blocks.zh: 对Imagine3D-LLM的一个中央设计选择是瓶颈M QQ K N ' M\ll KN^{\prime},它迫使各种观点的重叠内容被合并成一套共享的汇总符(§3.2.1). 为了检查这个瓶颈是否真的诱导对象级分组,我们通过K-means将经过训练的汇总符号分组,并对每个集群的3D Gaussians从其成员符号解码. 如图3所示,一个单一集群的高斯人可靠地将一个物体(如主席)定位于所有观点,尽管模型没有得到集群监督。 这种新兴的组合有效地验证了通过一小组汇总符号来重新构建场景的学习,自然引导模型走向抽象的,对象层面的理解,我们的设计目的是实现,而不需要任何明确的对象层面的监督.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Following prior work [ 93 , 73 ] , we build our Imagine3D-LLM based on LLaVA-Video-7B [ 89 ] . LLaVA-Video encodes each image as 210 tokens, resulting in N ′ = 210 N^{\prime}=210 and K ​ N ′ = 6720 KN^{\prime}=6720 tokens for most settings where we use 32 images as input. For 3DGS estimation, we choose ℓ = 14 \ell=14 , as it is the middle layer of the base LLM. For the number of Gaussian summary tokens, we set M = 2592 M=2592 , which corresponds to 81 tokens per input image and is much fewer than the total number of image tokens K ​ N ′ = 6720 KN^{\prime}=6720 . The number of Gaussians decoded per token is set as G = 32 G=32 . The Gaussian decoder head ℋ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathcal{H}(\cdot) is a three-layer MLP. We fine-tune the entire model on the combination of ScanNet-based datasets (SQA3D [ 52 ] , ScanQA [ 3 ] , Scan2Cap [ 11 ] , ScanRefer [ 10 ] , and Multi3DRefer [ 88 ] ). Motivated by recent analysis [ 86 , 95 , 92 ] where training only with ScanNet-based datasets show largely overfitted results to ScanNet rather than unlocking 3D reasoning, we also sample and add 100K subset from SPAR-7M [ 87 ] . The training is conducted with 16 GH200 GPUs, with an effective batch size of 64 for 1 epoch. More detailed implementation details can be found in Appendix A .

blocks.en: Following prior work [ 93 , 73 , 92 , 30 ] , we evaluate on seven benchmarks. Six are from ScanNet [ 20 ] : SQA3D [ 52 ] , Real-3DQA [ 51 ] , and ScanQA [ 3 ] for situated and spatial reasoning, Scan2Cap [ 11 ] for 3D grounded captioning, and ScanRefer [ 10 ] and Multi3DRefer [ 88 ] for 3D object detection. We additionally evaluate on SPAR-Bench [ 87 ] , which assesses genuine 3D perception and reasoning across three cognitive levels: low-level (e.g., depth estimation), medium-level (e.g., view-change inference), and high-level (e.g., spatial imagination). Following prior work [ 96 , 93 , 73 , 92 , 23 , 30 ] , we use exact / refined-exact match (EM / EM-R) [ 32 , 96 , 51 ] on SQA3D and Real-3DQA, EM together with BLEU-4 [ 55 ] , METEOR [ 5 ] , ROUGE [ 47 ] , and CIDEr [ 71 ] on ScanQA, the same captioning metrics under IoU@0.5 on Scan2Cap, Acc@0.25/0.5 on ScanRefer and the corresponding F1 on Multi3DRefer, and accuracy per cognitive level with the overall mean on SPAR-Bench.

blocks.en: 4.1 Quantitative Comparison
blocks.zh: 4.1 定量比较

blocks.en: On the ScanNet-based benchmarks (SQA3D [ 52 ] , Real-3DQA [ 51 ] , ScanQA [ 3 ] , Scan2Cap [ 11 ] , ScanRefer [ 10 ] , and Multi3DRefer [ 88 ] ), we compare Imagine3D-LLM against task-specific specialists, general-purpose 2D LMMs, and recent 3D LMMs that differ in how they encode the 3D scene. As shown in Tab. 1 , and Tab. 2 , Imagine3D-LLM significantly improves performance across benchmarks, outperforming the strongest prior 3D LMM (Ross3D) on almost all benchmarks. Especially, state-of-the-art performance in Real-3DQA is notable, which is a benchmark explicitly designed to validate 3D reasoning capabilities and penalize language-shortcut overfitting [ 51 ] , indicating that our improvements stem from genuine 3D reasoning.
blocks.zh: 在基于ScanNet的基准(SQA3D [52],Real-3DQA [51],ScanQA [3],Scan2Cap [11],Scan2Refer [10],和Multi3Drefer [88])上,我们比较了Imagine3D-LLM与任务特定专家,通用的2D LMM,以及最近的3D LMM,它们是如何编码3D场景的. 如 Tab. 1 和 Tab 所示。 2, imagine3D- LLM显著地改进了跨基准的性能,在几乎所有基准上都超过了之前最强的3D LMM(Ross3D). 特别是,Real-3DQA中最先进的性能值得注意,这是一个明确用来验证3D推理能力和惩罚语言短音偏差[51]的基准,表明我们的改进来自真正的3D推理.

blocks.en: On SPAR-Bench [ 87 ] , we compare Imagine3D-LLM against three categories of models: the proprietary group [ 34 , 2 ] , the general-purpose 2D LMMs group [ 89 , 75 , 67 , 4 ] , and the spatially-aware group of recent models specifically designed for spatial reasoning [ 23 , 30 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 在SPAR-Bench[87]上,我们比较了Impulation3D-LLM与三类模型:专有组[34,2],通用的2D LMMs组[89,75,67,4],以及最近专门为空间推理设计的空间意识组[23,30,17].

blocks.en: Table 3: Evaluation on SPAR-Bench [ 87 ] .
blocks.zh: 表3:对SPAR-Bench的评价 [87].

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 3 , Imagine3D-LLM achieves state-of-the-art performance on SPAR-Bench, outperforming all competing methods across every cognitive level by substantial margins. Compared to general-purpose 2D LMMs, Imagine3D-LLM surpasses even the largest 72B-scale model [ 4 ] by over 29 points despite using a 7B backbone. More notably, Imagine3D-LLM outperforms the strongest spatially-aware baseline, 3DThinker-7B [ 17 ] , by 5.2 points overall, with even larger margins over G 2 ​ VLM \text{G}^{2}\text{VLM} -SR-2B [ 30 ] and VLM3R-7B [ 23 ] . The improvement is especially pronounced on the medium- and high-level splits, which most directly require the object-level cross-view reasoning our reconstruction objective targets. These results validate our central claim: equipping MLLMs to assemble a compact 3D representation of the scene before answering substantially improves 3D reasoning.
blocks.zh: 如塔布所示. 3, imagine3D-LLM在SPAR-Bench上实现最先进的性能, 在所有认知层次上都以相当的边际胜过所有相互竞争的方法. 与通用的2D LMM相比,尽管使用了7B主干线,但Imagine3D-LLM甚至超过了最大的72B级模型[4] 超过29分. 更显著的是, 想象3D-LLM比最强的空间认知基线3DThinker-7B[17], 总体比5.2点, 比G 2 VLM 更远 \text{G}^{2}\Text{VLM} -SR-2B [30] 和VLM3R-7B [23]. 这种改进在中高层次的划分上尤为明显,这最直接地需要我们重建目标的目标对象层面的交叉观点推理. 这些结果验证了我们的中心主张:在回答3D推理之前,装备MLLMs组装一个紧凑的3D场景代表.

blocks.en: 4.2 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.2 阅读研究

blocks.en: To isolate the contribution of our mental-reconstruction objective from the effect of the training data and recipe, we compare Imagine3D-LLM against a baseline that shares the identical backbone, training data, and schedule but omits the Gaussian summary tokens together with the reconstruction and distillation objectives, i.e., standard visual instruction tuning. Here, we report one representative metric per benchmark EM score for SQA3D / ScanQA, ROUGE for Scan2Cap, Acc@25 for ScanRefer, F1@0.25 for Multi3DRefer, and average performance SPAR. As shown in Tab. 4 , Imagine3D-LLM improves over this controlled baseline on every benchmark, confirming that the gains arise from our objective rather than from the additional training data alone. The improvement is especially pronounced on the medium-level cross-view split of SPAR-Bench (+15.5, from 51.5 to 67.0; see Tab. 3 ), which most directly exercises the object-level cross-view reasoning our reconstruction objective targets.

blocks.zh: 表5:高斯令牌解码的l\ell层的效果.

blocks.en:
We further ablate the choice of the LLM layer ℓ \ell from which the Gaussian summary tokens are extracted and decoded into 3D Gaussians.
As discussed in § 3.2.1 , we hypothesize that the middle layer of the LLM offers the best balance between two opposing requirements: the Gaussian tokens must accumulate enough visual information to faithfully describe the scene, yet the remaining layers must be sufficient to propagate this 3D-aware information into the text tokens for reasoning. We empirically verify this by extracting from layer ℓ ∈ { 7 , 14 , 21 } \ell\in\{7,14,21\} of the 28-layer LLM. As shown in Tab. 5 , the middle layer ( ℓ = 14 \ell=14 ) consistently performs best, validating our design choice and aligning with prior findings on information flow in MLLMs [ 40 , 38 , 84 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们进一步放弃LLM层l\ell的选择,从中提取高斯摘要符号并解码成3D高斯.
正如第3.2.1节所讨论的,我们假设LLM的中间层在两个对立的要求之间提供了最佳的平衡:高斯令牌必须积累足够的视觉信息来忠实地描述场景,然而剩下的图层必须足以将这种3D-意识信息传播到文本令牌中进行推理. 我们通过从LLM 28 层的 LLM 中提取 { 7, 14, 21}\ ell\ in 7, 14, 21} 来经验验证这一点。 如塔布所示. 5,中层(l = 14\ell = 14) 一贯表现最好,验证我们的设计选择,并与先前关于MLLMs[40,38,84]中信息流的调查结果保持一致.

blocks.en: Table 6: Effect of distillation from the compact Gaussian teacher.
blocks.zh: 表6:精密高斯教师的蒸馏效果。

blocks.en: We compare our full model against a variant trained without the distillation losses ( ℒ token \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{token}} and ℒ param \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{param}} ). As shown in Tab. 6 , removing distillation (see Recon. only 1 epoch) causes a substantial drop on both benchmarks. We empirically observe that without distillation, ℒ recon \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{recon}} remains large in scale even after 1 epoch, so a large fraction of the gradient signal is allocated to reducing ℒ recon \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{recon}} , leaving the language modeling objective under-optimized. Consistent with this, the variant improves steadily with longer training ( 1 → 2 → 4 1\rightarrow 2\rightarrow 4 epochs) and at 4 epochs nearly matches our full 1-epoch model. In contrast, the ℒ LM \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{LM}} -only baseline shows only modest improvements with slightly longer iterations (1 → \rightarrow 2 epochs), and performance decreases after 4 epochs due to the model overfitting to the training data and losing general reasoning performance when only trained with ℒ LM \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{LM}} . Together, these results indicate that the improved 3D reasoning comes primarily from jointly learning reconstruction and understanding, with distillation serving mainly to accelerate convergence and make training practical.

blocks.en: Having established that reconstruction, not longer training, drives the gains, we next ask whether the improvement truly comes from learning to reconstruct the scene (mental reconstruction), or merely from access to the teacher’s representation, the distillation signal, or the added token capacity. We disentangle these factors in Tab. 7 . First, feeding the teacher’s query tokens directly to the LLM as additional input ( + Teacher tokens ), without asking the model to reconstruct, performs on par with the baseline. Second, supervising the summary tokens with the distillation loss but without the reconstruction loss ( + Distill. only ) likewise fails to help. We attribute both negative results to a representational mismatch between the teacher’s query tokens and the LLM’s own embedding space: simply injecting or distilling these tokens does not teach the LLM how to interpret or attend to them, and without a dedicated mechanism to compensate for this misalignment or to explicitly force the language model to attend to the injected tokens, as in feature-fusion approaches such as VLM3R [ 23 ] the added tokens are largely ignored, leaving performance at the baseline level. In contrast, the reconstruction loss compels the Gaussian summary tokens to actively attend to the image tokens and extract the visual evidence required to estimate their 3D Gaussian parameters. This active aggregation reshapes the attention and representations within the LLM such as sharpening cross-view correspondence and inducing object-level grouping (§ 3.3 ), which we believe iss what benefits downstream reasoning. Together, these results indicate that the improvement arises primarily from jointly learning mental reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 在确定了重建,而不是更长时间的训练来推动成果之后,我们接着问,改善是否真正来自学习到重建现场(精神重建),还是仅仅来自获得教师代表、蒸馏信号或附加的象征性能力。 我们在Tab中解开这些因素。 7,首先,将教师的查询符直接输入LLM作为附加输入(+教师符),而不要求模型重建,并按基线进行。 第二,监督汇总符号与蒸馏损失,但不包括重建损失(仅+Distill.)同样无济于事。 我们把负面结果归咎于教师的查询符和LLM本身的嵌入空间之间的代表不匹配:简单地注射或蒸馏这些符号并不能教LLM如何解释或关注这些符号,也没有专门的机制来弥补这种错位,或者明确迫使语言模型去关注注入符号,比如在像VLM3R[23]这样的特征集成方法中,添加的符号基本上被忽略,将性能留在基线水平. 与此相反,重建损失迫使高斯摘要符号积极关注图像符号并提取估计其3D高斯参数所需的视觉证据. 这种积极汇总重新塑造了LLM内部的注意力和表示,例如加强交叉视图的函证和诱导对象级分组(§3.3),我们认为这有利于下游推理. 这些结果表明,改善主要来自共同学习精神重建。

blocks.en: An important design choice of Imagine3D-LLM is that the Gaussian summary tokens act as a representational bottleneck, encouraging multi-view content corresponding to the same 3D region to be merged into shared tokens (§ 3.2.1 ). To validate this design, we ablate the number of summary tokens M M while keeping all other components fixed. As reported in Tab. 8 , we compare introducing roughly 40, 80, 160 tokens per image, which makes the total number of summary tokens 1296, 2592, 5184, given 32 images. The evaluation shows that too few tokens (1296) provide insufficient capacity, while too many tokens (5184) weaken the bottleneck that drives object-level grouping, leading both extremes to underperform our chosen setting.
blocks.zh: "Imagine3D-LLM"的一个重要设计选择是,高斯语摘要符号起到代表瓶颈的作用,鼓励与同一3D区域对应的多视图内容被合并为共享符号(§3.2.1). 为了验证这个设计,我们放弃了M M的汇总符号数量,同时保持所有其他组件的固定. 如塔布所报. 8,我们比较了大约40,80,160个每个图像的代号,这使得1296,2592,5184的即兴代号总数达到32个图像. 评价显示,太少的令牌(1296年)提供了不足的能力,而太多的令牌(5184年)削弱了驱动对象级分组的瓶颈,导致两个极端都未能很好地完成我们所选择的设定.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented Imagine3D-LLM, a framework that equips a multi-image MLLM with the ability to perform an explicit mental reconstruction of a 3D scene before answering. We introduce a compact set of learnable Gaussian summary tokens that are appended to the image tokens and decoded into a compact 3DGS representation, jointly trained with the standard language modeling objective. Across challenging spatial reasoning benchmarks, Imagine3D-LLM significantly outperforms prior approaches that rely on explicit pixel-level geometry or geometry-foundation features, and our analyses further reveal that the reconstruction objective propagates beyond the Gaussian summary tokens, reshaping the image features into more spatially aligned and semantically structured representations. We believe that enabling machines to understand how the scene is structured before answering offers a promising step toward MLLMs that perceive 3D space in a more human-like manner.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Imagine3D-LLM,这个框架使一个多图像的MLLM具备在回答之前对3D场景进行明确精神重建的能力. 我们采用一套紧凑的可学习高斯语摘要符号,附在图像符号上,并解码为紧凑的3DGS代表,与标准语言建模目标共同训练. 在整个具有挑战性的空间推理基准中,Imagine3D-LLM明显超越了以往依赖清晰的像素水平几何或几何基础特征的方法,我们的分析还进一步揭示,重建目标传播到高斯摘要符号之外,将图像特征重塑为空间上更加一致和结构化的表示. 我们认为,使机器在回答之前能够了解场景的结构,这为MLLM以更像人的方式看待三维空间提供了一个很有希望的步骤。

blocks.en: Following 3DRS [ 33 ] , we evaluate cross-view feature correspondence as a quantitative probe of how 3D-aware the image-token representations have become. We voxelize the 3D coordinates associated with image tokens with the given 3D point clouds for each scene of ScanNet [ 20 ] , construct cross-view pairs from tokens in different views that fall into the same voxel, and report the correspondence score as the average cosine similarity between the ℓ \ell -th layer hidden states of these pairs. A higher score indicates stronger feature consistency for image tokens describing the same 3D region across viewpoints. As shown in Fig. 4 , correspondence scores in the middle LLM layers, particularly the layers ℓ = 11 ∼ 18 \ell=11\sim 18 that surround the Gaussian decoding layer, improve substantially throughout training. This finding plays a dual role. As a corollary, it confirms that reconstruction supervision propagates 3D-aware structure beyond the summary tokens themselves into the image-token representations. We further attribute this propagation to our compact-bottleneck design ( M ≪ K ​ N ′ M\ll KN^{\prime} ): with far fewer summary tokens than image tokens, each summary token is forced to aggregate the same 3D region across multiple views, which in turn pressures the upstream image features to encode that region consistently across viewpoints. More importantly, the result shows that joint reconstruction delivers the kind of cross-view correspondence that prior methods such as 3DRS supply through explicit supervision: improved correspondence emerges naturally from learning to reconstruct, without ever being directly optimized.
blocks.zh: 在3DRS [33] 之后,我们评价交叉视图特征通信,作为3D-认知到图像-toke表达方式的量化探针. 我们用ScanNet [20] 的每个场景与给定的3D点云与图像符号相关的3D坐标进行voxelize,在属于同一 voxel 的不同视图中从符号中构建交叉视图对子,并将对应的比分报告为这些对子的l\ell - 第一层隐藏状态之间的平均余弦相似性. 较高的分数表明,描述同一三维区域的不同视角的图像符号的特性更加一致。 如图4所示,函授在LLM中层,特别是环绕高斯解码层的L=11 ∼ 18\ell=11\sim 18层的分数,在整个训练过程中大为改善. 这一发现具有双重作用。 作为必然结果,它确认重建监督将3D-意识结构传播到图像的表达方式中。 我们进一步将这种传播归因于我们的紧凑-瓶颈设计(M Q Q K N ' M\ll KN^{\prime):由于简单符号比图像符号要少得多,每个简要符号被迫通过多种观点将同一个3D区域聚合起来,这反过来又迫使上游图像特性对这个区域进行一致的跨观点编码。 更重要的是,结果显示,联合重建提供了诸如3DRS通过明确监督提供之前的交叉视图通信:改进后的通信从学习到重建自然而然地出现,而从未直接得到优化。

blocks.en: C.3 Additional quantitative evaluation of semantic feature structuring
blocks.zh: C.3 对语义特征结构的其他定量评价

blocks.en: The PCA visualizations in Fig. 2 and the cross-view correspondence analysis in Appendix B provide qualitative and geometric evidence that joint reconstruction training improves the LLM’s image features. To obtain a more direct quantitative measure of whether the features become more semantically structured, we conduct an unsupervised semantic segmentation probe following the standard evaluation methodology of [ 19 , 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 图2中的PCA可视化和附录B中的交叉视图函证分析提供了定性和几何证据,表明联合重建培训改善了LLM的形象特征. 为了更直接地衡量这些特征是否变得结构化,我们按照[19,26]的标准评估方法,进行了无监督的语义分解探测。

blocks.en: Specifically, on the ScanNet scenes of the SQA3D evaluation set (which provide per-image 2D semantic labels), we extract the LLM’s image features at layer ℓ \ell for all 32 input views and apply K-means clustering jointly over all views’ tokens, with k k set to the number of ground-truth NYU40 classes present in the scene. Since the resulting clusters carry no labels, we follow the standard unsupervised segmentation protocol: each cluster is assigned to its maximally-overlapping ground-truth class via majority vote. After assignment, cluster labels are upsampled to the label resolution and we compute mIoU against the ground-truth semantic masks, aggregated across all views of each scene. As DINOv3 [ 65 ] features are well-known to be semantically structured, we additionally evaluate DINOv3 under the same protocol as an upper-bound reference.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,在SQA3D评价集的ScanNet场景(提供每个图像的2D语义标签)上,我们提取LLM的图像特性在l-\ell层中,用于所有32个输入视图,并在所有视图的符号上联合应用K-手段组合,其中kk设置到现场的地面真实NYU40类的数量. 由于由此产生的集群没有标签,我们遵循标准无监督的分区协议:每个集群通过多数表决被分配到其最大程度重叠的地面真实级. 任务结束后,集群标签被检测到标签分辨率,我们对照地面真实语义口罩计算mIoU,在每一个场景的所有视图中汇总. 由于DINOv3 [65] 特征众所周知是集成结构的,我们根据同一协议额外评价DINOv3为上限参考.

blocks.en: As reported in Tab. 9 , our model’s image features achieve 35.43 mIoU, a substantial improvement over the baseline (26.54) that closes much of the gap to DINOv3 (37.62). This result provides direct evidence that the feature space itself, not only its downstream usage, becomes more semantically structured through joint reconstruction training. Importantly, this structuring emerges as a byproduct of the reconstruction objective—the image features are never directly supervised with semantic labels—confirming that learning to reconstruct propagates object-level structure into the LLM’s visual representations.
blocks.zh: 如塔布所报. 9,我们模型的图像特性达到了35.43 mIoU,比基线(26.54)大有改进,这与DINOv3(37.62)的缺口相近。 这一结果直接证明,地物空间本身,不仅是其下游用途,通过联合重建培训,变得更加精密。 重要的是,这种结构是重建目标的副产品——图像特征从未直接受到语义标签的监督——确认学会重建物体层次结构将传播到LLM的视觉表现中。

blocks.zh: C.4 对重建质量的补充定量评价

blocks.en: Table 10: Reconstruction quality on SQA3D test scenes. We compare the rendering quality of our Gaussian summary tokens against the compact Gaussian teacher [ 72 ] used during training. Higher is better for PSNR and SSIM; lower is better for LPIPS.

blocks.en: While our primary goal is to improve 3D reasoning rather than novel view synthesis, here we further analyze rendering quality on the SQA3D test scenes and compare against the compact Gaussian teacher [ 72 ] in Tab. 10 . As expected, our reconstruction quality is somewhat below the teacher’s, since our Gaussians are decoded from the hidden states of an LLM that is jointly optimized for language modeling and reconstruction, trained with much fewer iterations, and without any special design to match the teacher’s rendering fidelity. However, the primary goal of our design is not to achieve high-fidelity rendering: the reconstruction objective serves as an inductive bias that teaches the model how the scene is structured (mental reconstruction), not as a novel view synthesis system (§ 3.2.1 ).
blocks.zh: 尽管我们的首要目标是改进3D推理而不是新颖的视角综合,但我们在此进一步分析SQA3D测试场景的质量,并与Tab 10中紧凑的高斯老师[72]进行比较。 正如人们所期望的那样,我们的重建质量略低于教师的水平,因为我们的高斯老师从一个LLM的隐藏状态中解码出来,这个LLM是共同优化语言模型和重建的,训练的频率要低得多,没有任何特殊的设计来匹配教师的忠诚度。 然而,我们设计的首要目标并不是实现高真实度的渲染:重建目标是一种诱导性偏差,它教导模型如何构建场景(精神重建),而不是一种新颖的视角合成系统(第3.2.1节).

blocks.en: C.5 Additional analysis between Gaussian summary token and multi-view images
blocks.zh: C.5 高斯摘要符号与多视图图像之间的进一步分析

blocks.en:
To accurately reconstruct the scene, it is crucial for the Gaussian summary tokens to effectively aggregate information from multi-view images. We conduct additional analysis to examine how Gaussian summary tokens attend to multi-view image features when generating 3D Gaussians. As shown in Fig. 7 , each Gaussian summary token attends to corresponding regions of the same object across multiple views in the scene.
This behavior emerges because a limited number of Gaussian summary tokens are compelled to aggregate multiple occurrences of the same object into a single representation, effectively clustering common objects without any explicit supervision.
This emergent object-centric property is reminiscent of human perception, where the same object observed from multiple viewpoints is interpreted as a single entity to form a coherent 3D understanding of the scene.

为了准确地重建场景,高斯摘要符号对于有效汇总多视图图像的信息至关重要. 我们进行更多的分析,以检查高斯摘要符号在生成3D高斯语时如何处理多视图图像特征. 如图7所示,每个高斯语摘要符号都会在现场的多个视图中覆盖同一物体的相应区域.

blocks.en: We further analyze the additional training-time cost incurred by our reconstruction and distillation objectives. As reported in Tab. 11 , augmenting the standard language modeling loss with ℒ recon \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{recon}} and ℒ distill \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{distill}} raises the peak per-GPU VRAM from 40 GB to 44 GB, a 10% increase under identical batch size and sequence length. This modest overhead is a direct consequence of our design choice to keep the number of Gaussian summary tokens compact ( M = 2592 M=2592 , § \lx@sectionsign 3.2.1 ). To make this concrete, pixel-aligned feed-forward 3DGS estimators [ 9 , 16 , 28 , 83 ] predict one Gaussian per input pixel, which for our setting of 32 images at 384 × 384 384\times 384 resolution would amount to roughly 4.7M Gaussians per scene. In contrast, Imagine3D-LLM decodes only M × G = 2592 × 32 ≈ 83 ​ K M\times G=2592\times 32\approx 83\text{K} Gaussians, less than 1.8% of the pixel-aligned count. This compactness keeps the rasterization, the teacher forward pass, and the gradient buffers comparatively lightweight, allowing the reconstruction objective to fit alongside MLLM finetuning at a manageable cost. The overhead is also confined to training, as the compact Gaussian teacher [ 72 ] is discarded at inference time and the Gaussian decoder head ℋ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathcal{H}(\cdot) is only invoked when reconstructions are explicitly required. Given the substantial gains in 3D reasoning across all evaluated benchmarks (Tab. 1 , 2 , 3 ), we view this as a favorable trade-off, indicating that imagining the scene through a compact Gaussian abstraction is not only effective but also practically affordable.

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 12 , Imagine3D-LLM uses 20.43 GB and 176.9 ms per sample, compared to the baseline’s 17.09 GB and 112.1 ms. The additional overhead compared to the baseline comes almost entirely from the longer input sequence ( M = 2592 M=2592 additional summary tokens), as the Gaussian decoder head is only invoked when the user explicitly requests a reconstruction and the distillation teacher is discarded after training. Importantly, approaches like VLM3R that fuse external 3D foundation model features must run a separate model (CUT3R) on all input frames at inference before fusion, resulting in substantially higher memory (25.29 GB) and latency (344 ms). Our approach requires no external 3D model at inference, keeping the cost well below that of feature-fusion alternatives while still providing substantial reasoning gains.

blocks.en: C.7 Visualization of estimated Gaussians.
blocks.zh: C.7 估计高斯人可视化。

blocks.en: While our main objective is improving 3D reasoning rather than achieving photorealistic novel view synthesis, we additionally visualize the estimated Gaussians in 3D to verify that the Gaussian summary tokens indeed acquire a coherent 3D understanding of the scene. As shown in Fig. 8 , the rendered views recover the overall layout of the scene and the rough placement of major objects (e.g., the central table surface and surrounding seating arrangement), confirming that even when decoded from only M = 2592 M=2592 summary tokens, the model is able to organize multi-view evidence into a spatially consistent 3D abstraction. We emphasize, however, that the rendering quality itself is not the primary concern of Imagine3D-LLM. Unlike feed-forward 3DGS estimators that are explicitly optimized for high-fidelity novel view synthesis [ 9 , 16 , 28 , 83 , 37 ] , our Gaussian summary tokens are trained jointly with the language modeling objective and are bottlenecked to a small set of tokens, which inherently trades off pixel-level fidelity for compact, object-level abstraction.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的主要目标是改进3D推理,而不是实现光现实主义小说观点合成,但我们在3D中额外将估计的高斯人目视化,以验证高斯语摘要符号确实获得了对场景的一致的3D理解. 如图8所示,提供的观点恢复了场景的整体布局和主要物体的粗糙布局(如中央表面和周围的座位安排),确认即使从仅有的M=2592 M=2592摘要符号解码,模型也能将多视图证据组织成空间一致的3D抽象. 然而,我们强调,提供质量本身不是Imagine3D-LLM的主要关切。 与Feed-forward 3DGS的刻度器明确优化于高清小说视图合成[9,16,28,83,37]不同的是,我们的高斯摘要符号与语言建模目标一起训练,并瓶颈于一小串符号,其内在的将像素级的忠诚性与紧凑,对象级的抽象进行交易.

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional Related Works
blocks.zh: 附录D 相关作品

blocks.en: Because our framework incorporates 3D Gaussian Splatting within an MLLM, several existing directions may appear superficially related to Imagine3D-LLM. We briefly discuss them here and clarify the key distinctions.
blocks.zh: 因为我们的框架将3D Gaussian Splateting 包含在 MLLM 中, 几个现有的方向可能表面上看起来与 imagine3D-LLM 有关. 我们在这里简要讨论这些问题,并澄清关键区别。

blocks.en: SplatTalk [ 68 ] also pairs a feed-forward 3DGS estimator with an MLLM, but uses 3DGS as an external feature lifter : a frozen estimator (FreeSplat [ 77 ] ) lifts pretrained 2D features into a 3D Gaussian field that is then fed to the LLM as visual tokens. The MLLM itself never learns to reconstruct the scene. In contrast, Imagine3D-LLM equips the MLLM with learnable Gaussian summary tokens that jointly learn to reconstruct the scene and support language modeling, with no external 3DGS module at inference.
blocks.zh: SplateTalk [68] 还用MLLM对一个向导的3DGS估计器,但使用3DGS作为外部特性提升器:一个冷冻估计器(FreeSplate [77])将预先训练的2D特性提升到一个3D高斯场,然后作为视觉符号输入LLM. MLLM本身从未学会重建场景. 与之相对的是,Imagine3D-LLM为MLLM配备了可学习的高斯摘要符号,这些符号共同学习重建场景并支持语言模型,没有外部3DGS模块进行推论.

blocks.en: LangSplat [ 59 ] , FMGS [ 98 ] , and M3 [ 97 ] distill 2D foundation features into 3D Gaussians optimized per scene, enabling open-vocabulary retrieval or segmentation. Imagine3D-LLM targets a different setting: a feed-forward generalist that answers natural-language questions about novel scenes in a single forward pass, without per-scene optimization.
blocks.zh: LangSplate [59], FMGS [98],和M3 [97] 蒸馏2D基础特征,形成每个场景优化的3D Gaussians,允许开放的vocabulary检索或分区. imagine3D-LLM针对不同的设定:一个feed-forward generalist,在单个前传中解答关于小说场景的自然语言问题,没有进行每个场景的优化.

blocks.en: SpatialLM [ 53 ] feeds 3D point clouds to an MLLM and outputs structured bounding-box coordinates and labels from a fixed vocabulary. Imagine3D-LLM instead targets free-form 3D understanding—spatial QA, situated reasoning, dense captioning, and grounding—through natural language interaction.

blocks.en: The most conceptually similar concurrent work is 3DThinker [ 17 ] , which also argues for “thinking with 3D” before answering spatial questions. 3DThinker aligns latent reasoning tokens with features from a frozen 3D foundation model (VGGT [ 74 ] ), placing it closer to methods that fuse geometry-foundation features into MLLMs (e.g., VLM3R [ 23 ] , G 2 \text{G}^{2} VLM [ 30 ] ). Imagine3D-LLM instead requires the Gaussian summary tokens to actually reconstruct the scene through differentiable rasterization, providing a stronger inductive bias toward 3D-aware internal representations (§ 3.3 ). Empirically, Imagine3D-LLM outperforms 3DThinker-7B by 5.2 points on SPAR-Bench overall, with larger margins on the medium- and high-level reasoning splits.
blocks.zh: 概念上最相似的并行工作是3DThinker[17],它也主张在回答空间问题之前“与3D进行思考”。 3DThinker将潜在推理符与冷冻的3D基础模型(VGGT [74])的特征相配合,将其置于更接近于将几何建立特征连接到MLLMs(如VLM3R [23],G 2\text{G}^{2}VLM [30])的方法. 想象3D-LLM相反要求高斯摘要符号通过不同的光栅化来实际重建场景,为3D-意识的内部表示提供了更强烈的诱导偏差(§3.3). 经验性地说,Imagine3D-LLM在SPAR-Bench整体上比3DThinker-7B的成绩高出5.2分,中高层次推理分裂的边距更大.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en: While Imagine3D-LLM demonstrates that abstract reconstruction is an effective inductive bias for 3D-aware MLLMs, training efficiency remains a limitation. As discussed in § 3.2.2 , our framework can learn Gaussian summary tokens without a pretrained compact Gaussian teacher [ 72 ] , but requires more training steps to achieve comparable downstream performance. The teacher therefore accelerates convergence rather than being a necessary component of our framework. Improving the efficiency of teacher-free training remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 虽然Imagine3D-LLM表明抽象重建对于3D-意识的MLLM是一种有效的诱导偏差,但培训效率仍然是一个局限性. 如第3.2.2节所述,我们的框架可以在没有经过事先训练的紧凑型高斯教师的情况下学习高斯语摘要符号[72],但需要更多的培训步骤来实现类似的下游成绩. 因此,教师加速了趋同,而不是成为我们框架的必要组成部分。 提高无师资培训效率仍然是今后工作的重要方向.

blocks.en: Another limitation concerns the scope of our training scenes and the fixed representation budget. Our model is trained on indoor scenes, where a fixed number of Gaussian summary tokens and decoded Gaussians has not posed a major constraint in our experiments. However, larger and more complex outdoor scenes may require a greater representation capacity, and the current Gaussian budget could be insufficient to capture their spatial structure. Extending our framework to cover both indoor and outdoor environments, and dynamically adapting the number of Gaussian summary tokens to the scale and complexity of each scene, are promising directions for future work.
blocks.zh: 另一个限制因素涉及我们培训场景的范围和固定代表预算。 我们的模型是经过室内场景训练的,其中固定数量的高斯摘要符号和解码的高斯符号并没有对我们的实验构成重大的制约. 然而,更大和更复杂的户外场景可能需要更大的代表能力,目前的高斯预算可能不足以捕捉它们的空间结构. 扩大我们的框架,以涵盖室内和室外环境,并动态地根据每个场景的规模和复杂性调整高斯摘要标志的数量,是未来工作的有希望的方向。
